query:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Frankenstein, Bob gets Moby Dick, and Claire gets The Fellowship of the Ring.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Alice and Bob swap books. Then, Claire and Alice swap books. Finally, Bob and Claire swap books. At the end of the semester, Claire has
Options:
(A) Frankenstein
(B) Moby Dick
(C) The Fellowship of the Ring
note: UNLABELED external package; reference = first successful rollout; all other successful rollouts are omitted so the annotator view matches annotate.py

steps.content: Claire ends up with (B) Moby Dick after all the swaps.
Claire ends up with Moby Dick after all the swaps.
